display_title: She Is No.1 Real-Time Search Keyword
description:
*"I should be in the hospital...?"*

Se-Ri wakes up from a car accident to find herself a celebrity on the verge of retirement.

 *"What did I do? Why does everyone hate me!!!"*

There are mountains of misunderstandings Se-Ri has to resolve. And Jeong-Min, who spent his childhood with Se-Ri, has become a successful actor in the entertainment industry. One day, Jeong-Min comes to her and suggests that they film a program together... Thanks to Jeong-Min's fame, the two of them keep rising in the real-time search rankings.

The relationship between us is familiar yet unfamiliar, close yet distant...?!

(Source: Comico, translated)
